creative.central_question: How do hundreds of AI agents build one thing together?
creative.payoff: Structure beats more agents: planners create tasks, workers finish them, a judge decides each cycle.
creative.visual_motif: The LOCK door: jammed by 20 robots at frame 0, standing open at the end.
creative.music: soft self-made pad only under hook, intro, lesson and outro; no music under explanation; no SFX
creative.palette: warm hard-hat amber and safety orange on deep slate; mint for the working state, coral for locks and churn (distinct from the teal office of 11-22)
creative.visual_world: Robot construction site building a giant browser window on scaffolding; many small hard-hat robots. Opening image: 20 robots jammed at one door marked LOCK. Camera path: jam -> pull back to scaffolded window -> queue -> idle sidelines -> churn -> org-chart B-roll (Planner/map, Workers/hammer, Judge/gavel) -> orderly site with task cards and judge stamp -> window lights up with RESEARCH PROJECT sign -> lesson B-roll -> back at the door, now open. Metaphor: kitchen with no head chef vs brigade, as a worksite with and without a foreman.

scenes.narration: Twenty AI agents worked like two or three.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: slow push-in on the jam; robots shuffle, one door sign pulses
scenes.visual_description: Frame 0: twenty small robots jammed at one door marked LOCK on a construction site; camera pushes in, hard hat bobbing.

scenes.narration: Then a clear team structure helped build a browser in about a week.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: pull back and rise to reveal scaffolded browser window; question mark pops above the door
scenes.visual_description: Camera pulls back: the same site, but behind the door a giant half-built browser window frame stands on scaffolding.

scenes.narration: Cursor says it began with equal agents and one shared lock file. Agents held locks too long, or forgot them.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: queue shuffles forward; held key glows amber; forgotten key blinks coral
scenes.visual_description: Robots queue at the LOCK door; one robot sits holding the key tag while others wait; a forgotten key lies on the floor.

scenes.narration: So twenty agents moved like two or three. They played it safe.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: idle robots dim to grey; 3 working robots stay lit; counter 20 to 3 ticks on a sign
scenes.visual_description: Only 2-3 robots work at the browser frame while 17 stand idle, tool belts untouched, hugging the sidelines.

scenes.narration: Next: optimistic concurrency. Simpler, but flawed.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: bricks placed then knocked off and redone, loop of rework; faint dust puffs
scenes.visual_description: Robots grab bricks at the same time and bump; some bricks get placed, knocked off, placed again.

scenes.narration: The fix: roles. Planners create tasks. Workers only finish them. A judge decides each cycle whether to continue.
scenes.visual_justification: Motion-text B-roll in the same robot-site world: Lucide icons (map, hammer, gavel) on a signboard show the Planner/Workers/Judge hierarchy; short proof/lesson insert.
scenes.motion: icons pop in on each role word; signal dot travels Planner to Workers to Judge; judge icon pulses at cycle end
scenes.visual_description: Motion-text org chart on dark board: Planner (map icon) -> Workers (hammer icon) -> Judge (gavel icon), arrows draw on in narration order.

scenes.narration: Cursor reports close to a week, over a million lines, about a thousand files. A browser from scratch.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: camera orbits the busy site; task cards fly planner to workers; stamp thumps; counters tick up (reported by Cursor)
scenes.visual_description: Orderly site: planner robot hands task cards to workers, judge robot stamps a clipboard each cycle; browser window rises with lines of code scrolling.

scenes.narration: It's an experiment. Cursor's CEO said it kind of works.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: browser window lights up unevenly, caption sign lowers; robots lean back, hard hats tilted
scenes.visual_description: Window flickers on with a few cracks and a patched corner; sign beside it: RESEARCH PROJECT.

scenes.visual_justification: Motion-text B-roll in the same robot-site world: Lucide icons (map, hammer, gavel) on a signboard show the Planner/Workers/Judge hierarchy; short proof/lesson insert.
scenes.motion: crowd icon fades, org-chart icon scales up with accent glow
scenes.visual_description: Motion-text card with Lucide icons: crowd of robots icon crossed out vs org chart icon highlighted.

scenes.narration: For more AI concepts like this, follow.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a robot construction site makes the lock jam, idle workers and role-based build physically visible.
scenes.motion: slow pull back; door sign LOCK swaps to OPEN; robots wave
scenes.visual_description: Return to the opening door: it now stands open, robots stream through to the finished browser window; follow cue lower third.
